dedupe_keys.name: remind regional model of investments and development

description: REMIND is a modular energy-economy model developed at the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research. It combines regional economic growth, energy technologies, trade and emissions constraints to optimize investment and transformation pathways. Users configure scenarios and technology assumptions in GAMS and R workflows. Outputs include the technical GDX solution and a CSV-format MIF report for further analysis. Spatial coverage is global and multiregional; the time horizon and time-step configuration belong to the chosen model version and scenario. Public source and tutorials are free under AGPL-3.0-or-later with the REMIND License Exception 1.0. Separate GAMS and solver requirements may incur costs. The model supports long-term climate-policy and energy-capacity studies. A limitation is its intertemporal optimization with perfect foresight, alongside substantial computing and data requirements. Existing data-ngfs-climate-scenarios includes scenarios produced using REMIND. This review checked current documentation and the article-linked 2.1.3 archive, without installing dependencies or reproducing the paper.
